definition: To pay attention to a sound or a person.
exampleSentence: I like to listen to podcasts while I am driving.

definition: To stay until someone arrives or something happens.
exampleSentence: We had to wait for the bus for almost twenty minutes.

definition: To turn your eyes toward something.
exampleSentence: Please look at the chart on the second slide.

definition: To be owned by someone.
exampleSentence: Excuse me, does this black umbrella belong to you?

definition: To have the same opinion as someone.
exampleSentence: I completely agree with your idea about the new logo.

definition: To formally ask for a job, visa or place.
exampleSentence: She decided to apply for a job at a tech company.

definition: To say that you want something.
exampleSentence: Do not be afraid to ask for help when you need it.

definition: To trust that something exists or is good.
exampleSentence: My coach taught me to believe in myself.

definition: To think something is important.
exampleSentence: Good companies really care about their customers and their employees.

definition: To say that you are unhappy with something.
exampleSentence: Many guests complain about the noise from the street at night.

definition: To give all your attention to something.
exampleSentence: Turn off your phone so you can focus on your work.

definition: To say firmly that something must happen.
exampleSentence: My parents always insist on paying for dinner.

definition: To give money to buy something.
exampleSentence: Who is going to pay for the taxi to the airport?

definition: To trust someone or something to help you.
exampleSentence: You can always rely on Maria to finish her work on time.

definition: To answer or react to something.
exampleSentence: Our support team tries to respond to every email within a day.

definition: To manage to do something.
exampleSentence: She worked hard to succeed in her new career.

definition: To have something in your mind.
exampleSentence: I need some time to think about your offer.

definition: To feel anxious about something.
exampleSentence: Do not worry about the exam; you are well prepared.

definition: To be made of certain parts.
exampleSentence: The course will consist of ten online lessons and a final test.

definition: To get ready for something.
exampleSentence: Students usually prepare for exams in the library.

definition: To look carefully to find something.
exampleSentence: The police continued to search for the missing hiker.

definition: To speak with someone.
exampleSentence: You should talk to your manager about a pay rise.

definition: To find someone or something funny.
exampleSentence: Everyone started to laugh at his silly jokes.

definition: To reach a building or a specific place.
exampleSentence: We will arrive at the hotel around six this evening.

definition: To imagine something you want, or to see it in sleep.
exampleSentence: Many children dream about becoming astronauts one day.

definition: Pleased about something you or others did.
exampleSentence: We are very proud of our daughter for winning the prize.

definition: Known by many people because of something.
exampleSentence: Italy is famous for its delicious food and beautiful cities.

definition: Having the duty to take care of something.
exampleSentence: The IT team is responsible for keeping our data safe.

definition: Almost the same as something.
exampleSentence: My new phone is very similar to my old one.

definition: Not the same as.
exampleSentence: Life in a big city is very different from life in a village.

definition: Containing a lot of something.
exampleSentence: The shopping mall was full of people on Saturday.

definition: Bored or annoyed by something that happens too often.
exampleSentence: I am tired of eating pasta every night this week.

definition: Knowing that something exists or is happening.
exampleSentence: Are you aware of the new rules for working from home?

definition: Having the ability to do something.
exampleSentence: This computer is capable of running several virtual machines at once.

definition: Very interested in or enthusiastic about something.
exampleSentence: My son is really keen on robotics and coding.

definition: Connected with something.
exampleSentence: Most of my questions are related to the new software update.

definition: Feeling happy and eager about something.
exampleSentence: The kids are excited about their trip to the zoo.

definition: Knowing something well.
exampleSentence: Are you familiar with the programming language we use here?

definition: Pleased with something.
exampleSentence: Most customers are satisfied with our delivery service.

definition: Having someone as your husband or wife.
exampleSentence: My cousin has been married to her husband for ten years.
